title: There’s a New Link Between Gut Health and Alzheimer’s Disease
summary: The model presented in the study functions as a chain: Certain gut bacteria produce ImP; the metabolite enters the bloodstream; it can compromise the blood-brain barrier and reach the brain; and, once there, it promotes changes related to amyloid beta and tau.
